name: vsp360-community
description: Community MCP server for Hitachi VSP 360: query alerts, inventory, capacity and performance through the VSP 360 REST API. Read-only by default. Not an official Hitachi Vantara product.

url.title: VSP 360 URL
url.description: Base URL of your VSP 360, e.g. https://vsp360.example.com

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of the VSP 360 service account

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: Client secret of the VSP 360 service account. Stored in your system's secure credential store.

toolsets.title: Direct toolsets
toolsets.description: Optional. Comma-separated API areas to expose as direct tools, e.g. Analytics / Query API,Device Registry,Platform Alerts

allow_writes.title: Allow writes
allow_writes.description: Allow operations that change VSP 360. Leave off for read-only access.

ca_cert.title: CA certificate
ca_cert.description: Optional. Path to the PEM file of the CA that signed the VSP 360 certificate

insecure_tls.title: Skip TLS verification
insecure_tls.description: Accept any certificate. For lab systems with self-signed certificates only.

download_dir.title: Download folder
download_dir.description: Optional. Where downloaded files are saved. Defaults to ~/Downloads/vsp360-mcp

upload_dir.title: Upload folder
upload_dir.description: Optional. The only folder files may be uploaded from. Read-only mode refuses uploads unless this is set.
